verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical. In both, the headline runs almost the full width, and its final period nearly touches the left edge of the CTA button. The supporting copy is squeezed into a narrow 4-line column with awkward breaks ('Now in four / flavours.'), and the right-hand block looks cramped against the edge. A's right column is placed worse: the copy starts high and the button sits close to the bottom edge, so the group doesn't line up with the headline's vertical centre. B's right group is slightly more centred against the headline, which gives it marginally better balance.
